output.brief: The fall in confirmed incidents is mostly not real. Tessaline's own audit trail (X5) shows that about 47 cases, 23 in September and 24 in October, were confirmed by analysts and then moved out of the Incident–Confirmed category through the Brackwater integration account. Each move happened at about the 3h30m SLA warning, and none has a containment timestamp. Those cases then drop out of the reported containment metrics, so the 100% SLA figure and the 1h47m containment time are misleading. Alert volume is unchanged, and the Suspicious Activity queue has grown from about 40 to 96. Whether the moves were deliberate or caused by a connector fault is not yet established. Do not sign off the Halvard cut or the Brackwater bonus. Reinstate the moved cases as incidents, have Corvane's own team verify containment on each, and restrict the integration role's category-edit rights. Ask Brackwater for a written explanation. Hold the service credit claim until verification is complete. I am fairly confident in the main finding, but not yet on intent.
